systematicBias.discriminator: Among 16 acceleration groups, UNCLEAR ⊆ those with ≥1 CONFLICTING/CONFLICT_EXPLAINED sourceRelation bucket inside maneuver window
systematicBias.qcPipelineNote: UNTRUSTED is applied when S1 marks cross-source conflict; occurs when sparse integer OBD is present and disagrees with L3 — not an acceleration-specific QC rule

computeDiV0TripIntervals.role: Derives L3 speed per shadow bucket; sets sourceRelation via assessSourceRelationAtLabel(l3, r1, calibration)

assessSourceRelationAtLabel.policy: CONFLICT_EXPLAINED when |OBD-L3| ≥ max(abs, 25% L3); CONFLICTING in between corroboration and conflict bands; OBD INTERVAL_ONLY

trustSemantics.UNTRUSTED: Includes CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT when shadow.sourceRelation is CONFLICTING or CONFLICT_EXPLAINED (before leg geometry checks)
trustSemantics.CONFLICTED_candidate_tier: LDI-10A: L3 vs OBD at candidate endpoints ≥ max(5 km/h, 25% L3) — separate from per-bucket QC label

evaluateDiV0SpeedQcInterval.frozenPinPolicy: LDI08 rows built with DI_V0_SPEED_QC_POLICY_V2 in ldi03-ruptela-combined-pin.lib.ts
